summary: Mechanical checks of UI copy and visuals against a product's ui-spec.json; a pass is not a copy or design review.

help:
usage: st uilint [-h] [--version] COMMAND ...

Mechanical checks of UI copy and visuals against a product's ui-spec.json. A
pass means only that the listed rules held; it is not a copy or design review.

positional arguments:
  COMMAND
    spec            Validate a ui-spec.json
    check-source    Scan UI source files for banned copy (offline)
    capture-script  Print a read-only page extractor for the caller's browser
                    eval (e.g. st browser eval --stdin)
    check           Check a captured snapshot against the spec's copy and
                    visual rules

options:
  -h, --help        show this help message and exit
  --version         show program's version number and exit
help.spec:
usage: st uilint spec [-h] ACTION ...

positional arguments:
  ACTION
    validate  Validate a spec (default ./ui-spec.json)

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
help.spec validate:
usage: st uilint spec validate [-h] [path]

positional arguments:
  path        Spec path (default ./ui-spec.json)

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
help.check-source:
usage: st uilint check-source [-h] [--spec SPEC] [--root ROOT]
                           [--format {text,json}]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --spec SPEC           Spec path (default ./ui-spec.json)
  --root ROOT           Directory the source globs are relative to (default:
                        the spec's directory)
  --format {text,json}
help.capture-script:
usage: st uilint capture-script [-h] [--state STATE]

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --state STATE  Optional label for the captured UI state, e.g. empty or error
help.check:
usage: st uilint check [-h] [--spec SPEC] [--format {text,json}] snapshot

positional arguments:
  snapshot              Snapshot JSON from capture-script, or - for stdin
                        (also accepts st browser eval's
                        BROWSER:OK|details:PATH summary line)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --spec SPEC           Spec path (default ./ui-spec.json)
  --format {text,json}

usage.cmd: st uilint check-source | st uilint capture-script | st browser eval --stdin | st uilint check -
usage.when: after changing product UI copy or styling in a repo with ui-spec.json
precautions: exit 1 = violations to fix; a pass is mechanical-only, not approval
follow the project standard in context for judgment
